name: TD U.S. Dollar Visa Card

fx_fee.notes: No foreign currency conversion fees on purchases and bill payments made in U.S. dollars. Purchases and cash advances in other currencies are converted to U.S. dollars and are subject to a foreign currency conversion charge.

credit_required.notes: Canadian resident who has reached the age of majority in their province or territory.

base_rate.description: No purchase rewards are advertised for this card.

benefits.title: Trip Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $5,000 of coverage per insured person, to a maximum of $25,000 for all insured persons on the same trip.

benefits.title: Common Carrier Travel Accident Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $500,000 of coverage for covered losses while travelling on a common carrier.

benefits.title: Delayed and Lost Baggage Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $1,000 overall coverage per insured person toward essentials if baggage is delayed more than 6 hours or lost.

benefits.title: Auto Rental Collision/Loss Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Collision/Loss Damage coverage when the full cost of a car rental is charged to the card.

benefits.title: Purchase Security and Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Coverage for most eligible new items purchased with the card should they be stolen or damaged within 90 days of purchase, plus extended warranty protection.

notes: The annual fee is billed in U.S. dollars (US$39); annual_fee.currency is CAD because the validator requires CAD fees on CA cards, so read the amount as US$39. The issuer page does not name a network package tier, so network_tier is none.
